API

Beneficiary

Operations

Every route this entity exposes. Each route links to its own reference on this page.

Method Route SDK operation Returns
POST /api/v1/beneficiaries/authorise/{id} create OK
POST /api/v1/beneficiaries create OK
POST /api/v1/beneficiaries/batchcreate create A BeneficiariesCreateResponse
GET /api/v1/beneficiaries list Returns the list of beneficiaries
GET /api/v1/merchants/{merchantID}/beneficiaries list A BeneficiaryPageResponse containing the list of beneficiaries
GET /api/v1/beneficiaries/export load Returns the list of beneficiaries in CSV format
GET /api/v1/merchants/{merchantID}/beneficiaries/{id} load The beneficiary record
GET /api/v1/beneficiaries/{id} load The beneficiary record
DELETE /api/v1/beneficiaries/{id} remove No result is returned
PUT /api/v1/beneficiaries/disable/{id} update The updated beneficiary record
PUT /api/v1/beneficiaries/enable/{id} update The updated beneficiary record
PUT /api/v1/beneficiaries/{id} update The updated beneficiary record

create

POST /api/v1/beneficiaries/authorise/{id}

Operation ID: AuthoriseBeneficiary.

Authentication: API key in the header (Bearer).

Parameters

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | id | path | string (uuid) | Yes | The ID of the beneficiary record to authorise. |

Responses

200: OK
202: Accepted

POST /api/v1/beneficiaries

Operation ID: CreateBeneficiary.

Authentication: API key in the header (Bearer).

Request body

application/json

Property Type Required Description
currency enum: NONE, GBP, EUR, USD, AUD, BGN, ... Yes Gets or Sets the currency.
destination object Yes
destination.accountID string (uuid) No If set it indicates that the counterparty is an internal belonging to the same merchant as the source account.
destination.addressLine1 string No Address line 1 for the counterparty.
destination.addressLine2 string No Address line 2 for the counterparty.
destination.beneficiaryID string (uuid) No If set it indicates that the counterparty is a beneficiary of the merchant.
destination.countryCode string No A country code for the counterparty. Optional to set and depending on the payment network does not always get set for pay ins
destination.emailAddress string No An email address for the counterparty. Optional to set and depending on the payment network does not always get set for pay ins.
destination.identifier object No
destination.identifier.accountNumber string No
destination.identifier.bic string No
destination.identifier.currency enum: NONE, GBP, EUR, USD, AUD, BGN, ... No The currency for the account.
destination.identifier.iban string No
destination.identifier.sortCode string No
destination.identifier.summary string No Summary of the account identifier's most important properties.
destination.name string No The name of the counterparty. For a person this should be their full name. For a company this should be their registered or trading name.
destination.phoneNumber string No A phone number for the counterparty. Optional to set and depending on the payment network does not always get set for pay ins.
destination.postCode string No Post code for the counterparty.
destination.postTown string No Post town for the counterparty.
destination.summary string No Gets a convenient summary representation of the counterparty.
id string (uuid) No
merchantID string (uuid) Yes Gets or Sets the merchant id.
name string Yes The descriptive name for the beneficiary.
sourceAccountIDs array of string (uuid) No
theirReference string No Optional reference that will be used by default as TheirReference when creating payouts to this beneficiary if no TheirReference is specified for the payout.

list

GET /api/v1/beneficiaries

Operation ID: GetBeneficiaries.

Authentication: API key in the header (Bearer).

Parameters

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | merchantID | query | string (uuid) | No | Optional. The ID of the merchant to retrieve the beneficiaries for. If not set beneficiaries for all merchants the user has access to will be returned | | pageNumber | query | integer (int32) | No | The page number from where records are retrieved. | | pageSize | query | integer (int32) | No | The number of records to be retrieved from a page. | | search | query | string | No | The text filter used to retrieve the records. | | currency | query | enum: NONE, GBP, EUR, USD, AUD, BGN, ... | No | The currency filter used to retrieve the records.. | | includeDisabled | query | boolean | No | If set to true will include disabled beneficiaries as well | | sort | query | string | No | Optional expression to sort the order of the beneficiaries. | | sourceAccountID | query | string (uuid) | No | Optional. The ID of the source account to filter beneficiaries by. |

Responses

200: Returns the list of beneficiaries

GET /api/v1/merchants/{merchantID}/beneficiaries

Operation ID: GetMerchantBeneficiaries.

Authentication: API key in the header (Bearer).

Parameters

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | merchantID | path | string (uuid) | Yes | The ID of the merchant to get the beneficiaries for. | | pageNumber | query | integer (int32) | No | The page number from where records are retrieved. | | pageSize | query | integer (int32) | No | The number of records to be retrieved from a page. | | search | query | string | No | The text filter used to retrieve the records.. | | currency | query | enum: NONE, GBP, EUR, USD, AUD, BGN, ... | No | The currency filter used to retrieve the records.. | | includeDisabled | query | boolean | No | If set to true will include disabled beneficiaries as well | | sort | query | string | No | Optional expression to sort the order of the beneficiaries. | | sourceAccountID | query | string (uuid) | No | Optional source account ID to filter beneficiaries by their source account. |

Responses

200: A BeneficiaryPageResponse containing the list of beneficiaries

GET /api/v1/beneficiaries/export

Operation ID: ExportBeneficiaries.

Authentication: API key in the header (Bearer).

Parameters

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | merchantID | query | string (uuid) | No | Optional. The ID of the merchant to retrieve the beneficiaries for. If not set beneficiaries for all merchants the user has access to will be returned | | pageNumber | query | integer (int32) | No | The page number from where records are retrieved. | | pageSize | query | integer (int32) | No | The number of records to be retrieved from a page. | | search | query | string | No | The text filter used to retrieve the records. | | currency | query | enum: NONE, GBP, EUR, USD, AUD, BGN, ... | No | The currency filter used to retrieve the records.. | | includeDisabled | query | boolean | No | If set to true will include disabled beneficiaries as well | | sort | query | string | No | Optional expression to sort the order of the beneficiaries. |

Responses

200: Returns the list of beneficiaries in CSV format

text/csv

The response is string (binary).

202: Accepted. The CSV file is being generated

GET /api/v1/merchants/{merchantID}/beneficiaries/{id}

Operation ID: GetMerchantBeneficiary.

Authentication: API key in the header (Bearer).

Parameters

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | merchantID | path | string (uuid) | Yes | The ID of the merchant to get the beneficiary for. | | id | path | string (uuid) | Yes | The beneficiaryID of the beneficiary to retrieve. |

Responses

200: The beneficiary record
